text: I am feeling very stressed because of my exams. I cannot focus on anything.
Went for an early morning walk by the lake. Feeling so grateful and full of peaceful joy today!
Everything went wrong in the team meeting. I felt completely frustrated and unheard by everyone.
Practiced breathing meditation for 15 minutes. Mind feels quiet, balanced, and serene.
Received positive feedback on our project presentation! Absolutely thrilled and proud of the teamwork.
